title: Charter Enrollment
scope: This ledger ranks states on NCES Digest public charter fall enrollment for 2022-23, and also reports public-school teacher, total staff, and instructional-aide full-time-equivalent counts for Fall 2022.
exclusions: Does not cover a directory of every U.S. district or advice about opening a charter.
heritage: Formerly School Districts Charter Schools and Education Staff
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from NCES Digest 2023 table 216.90, 2022-23 charter fall enrollment. States with a suppressed or blank cell are omitted. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary. Tableau companions compiled Aug 16, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

q: Charter-school enrollment by state, with public-school teachers, staff, and instructional aides.
lead: Public charter-school enrollment was 3,717,857 in 2022-23 (SRC-609-01). Massachusetts enrolled 47,993, rank 22 of 46 states with a published count (derived, SRC-609-01). Public schools employed 3,228,895 full-time-equivalent teachers in Fall 2022 (SRC-609-02). Massachusetts employed 76,978, rank 13 of 51 (derived, SRC-609-02).
